rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=1024, gs_n_iter=130, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.0, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-4 (search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB (init): gs_init_from_fbp False->True (FBP warm-start: Gaussian positions sampled prop to FBP^2, amps seeded from FBP intensity clamped to gs_amp_init_max=0.05). Base = iter-3 config (1024 Gaussians / 130 it -- the run-best-SSIM point). init-only change, ~0 extra per-step cost. PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-1 hr=0 SSIM 0.8032 (512G/150it, cold), iter-2 hr=0 SSIM 0.8048 (512G/220it, quality lever FLAT +0.0016), iter-3 hr=0 SSIM 0.8145 (1024G/130it, capacity +0.0097 BEST). hr pinned 0 at every iter (recon PSNR ~20.4 vs 128-view FBP baseline PSNR 35.97). FAILURE MODE: cold uniform-random init wastes Gaussians on background; combined with the coarse basis, the per-scene recon lands far below the strong sparse-FBP baseline on PSNR/RMSE -> hr=0. Warm-start is the documented untested lever for the new split. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): FBP warm-start anchors Gaussians on anatomy from iter 0, so SSIM lifts above iter-3 0.8145 (toward the FBP structure). FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8145 (no lift), warm-start does NOT rescue the coarse-basis ceiling on the new split -- consistent with findings 2026-06-03 (old-split v3 warm-start gave the SAME SSIM ~0.89 as cold, hr=0). hr expected 0 either way (even matching FBP PSNR 35.97 with a 1024-Gaussian mixture is implausible, and the metric is PSNR/RMSE-gated). val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT (gs_outer_wall_s=1080). BUDGET: init only -> same ~987s as iter-3 << 1080 wall. TRAJECTORY: iter-3 0.8145 (1024G cold, BEST) -> iter-4 warm-start test., gs_outer_wall_s=1080, gs_amp_init_max=0.05
